title: Southbound funds go wild: Minimax's fundraising ability is astonishing, buying scale exceeds Alibaba and Tencent

content_html:
The capital market is showing unprecedented investment enthusiasm for China's new generation of artificial intelligence technology. As one of the leading companies in the field of large models in the domestic market, Minimax Group Inc. recently topped the list, becoming the most favored Hong Kong stock among mainland investors.

According to the latest market data disclosed, in the past August, mainland investors through the Hong Kong Stock Connect channel cumulatively purchased shares of Minimax worth as high as 10.6 billion Hong Kong dollars. This impressive scale of capital inflow not only ranks among similar innovative enterprises but has even exceeded the同期 (same period) purchases by traditional internet giants like Alibaba and Tencent Holdings through Hong Kong Stock Connect, becoming a focal point of the market.

Since being officially included in the Hong Kong Stock Connect list on August 6 this year, mainland investors have quickly and firmly increased their holdings in this artificial intelligence startup. As of now, the cumulative shareholding ratio of mainland investors in the company has reached 9.7%, fully reflecting the strong confidence of the capital market in the commercialization prospects of large models and the growth potential of emerging AI unicorns.
